title: Oath Recharge Mechanic (Cloud STT, Cinematic, Energy Refill)
description: Implements the Oath-based recharge flow when the player presses the ring to a lantern battery socket. Captures voice, sends HTTPS to developer-provided STT, fuzzy-matches against the canonical Oath, and on success plays a green-aura recharge cinematic and refills ring energy; otherwise shows failure prompt and enforces cooldown. Integrates with builtin.inventory for the 'ring_energy' resource, builtin.use_interact or trigger volumes for socket proximity, and ui_ring_hud for prompts.
acceptance_notes: Must pass: oath_recharge_success_cloud, oath_recharge_failure_path, portable_battery_recharge_in_plaza. Audio capture bounded and cancellable; HTTP call respects 2.0s timeout; local override flag enables designer testing; ring_energy persists across scene transitions.
